name: Diarrhea
overview: Diarrhea is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include loose or liquid bowel movements. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: Health professionals note that diarrhea, also spelled diarrhoea, is the condition of having at least three loose, liquid, or watery bowel movements in a day.
Health professionals note that it often lasts for a few days and can result in dehydration due to fluid loss.
Health professionals note that signs of dehydration often begin with loss of the normal stretchiness of the skin and irritable behaviour.
In routine practice, this can progress to decreased urination, loss of skin color, a fast heart rate, and a decrease in responsiveness as it becomes more severe.
In routine practice, loose but non-watery stools in babies who are exclusively breastfed, however, are normal.

faq.question: Can I rely on this Diarrhea information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: When should I worry about diarrhea?
faq.answer: Consult a doctor if symptoms persist, worsen, recur frequently, or are accompanied by red-flag features described above.
